guide.dbv_world.0.1: The starter uses the world 5 player design. Close the doors and check control, oxygen, enclosure, fuel and water.
guide.dbv_world.0.2: Check DashPanels controls and actual propulsion before releasing dock mooring. The saved design retains switch states; propulsion is not guaranteed to be off.
guide.dbv_world.0.3: Right-click Jiuhu's Console for native target depth. Sneak-right-click for flagship management.
guide.dbv_world.0.4: Lift, ballast and propulsion keep upstream defaults. Controller depth is not keel clearance.
guide.dbv_world.1.1: The dashboard has left, right and combined engine power/reverse controls. Follow the labels and wiring; first test in shallow water.
guide.dbv_world.1.2: Differential thrust and reversal steer the vessel. Avoid conflicting individual and combined control signals.
guide.dbv_world.1.3: Stop propulsion while retaining power for oxygen and ballast. Return to dock, slow down and use Moor in the management panel.
guide.dbv_world.1.4: The design has eight propellers. Endurance, payload changes and emergency ascent are not yet verified. Qualification is not a performance guarantee.
guide.dbv_world.2.1: This vessel includes a mechanical-bearing contraption. Stop and disassemble it into blocks before starting block refit.
guide.dbv_world.2.2: The complete dynamic blueprint, device configuration and storage are captured in independent JSON. After destruction, use an onshore information panel and choose Restore at dock in Vessel archive.
guide.dbv_world.2.3: Find Jiuhu's Console in the Deep Blue Voyage creative tab.
guide.dbv_world.2.4: An independent airlock procedure has not been verified. Do not use the old angler starter's pump and door instructions.
